purpose: Teach: しだい/顔つき/過ぎ去っ/おねがい/ちがっ/あらわし/気が付く/どきどき

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、テスト結果届きしだい教えろよ
lines.en: Riku, tell me as soon as your test results show up.
lines.style: Quick, commanding opening. Direct eye contact. The tone of someone used to being obeyed. Impatient but affectionate underneath — she cares that he knows she wants to know.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、今日、顔つき暗いぞ、桜
lines.en: You look dark today. What's going on, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet, careful observation. Slower pace than his usual. Not accusatory — genuinely noticing something off. Leans forward slightly, meeting her eyes without pushing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前との中学時代、過ぎ去って早いな
lines.en: It's weird how fast middle school went by with you, you know?
lines.style: Soft, almost surprised at herself for saying it out loud. Slight hesitation before the thought lands. Wistful trailing-off. She's not quite meeting his eyes.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ノート貸してって、おねがいだろ?桜
lines.en: Hey, you need to borrow my notes? Come on, just ask.
lines.style: Wry half-smile in the voice. Teasing her for the way she asks — indirect, reluctant. Warm underneath. Handing her the notebook before she has to say it again.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の答え、俺とちがってるぞ
lines.en: Your answer's different from mine. Did you mess up?
lines.style: Light challenge in the opening. Not mean — playful sparring. Quick pace. The tone of someone checking if he actually knows his stuff or if he's just guessing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、絵で感情あらわしてんな、桜
lines.en: You're really good at putting feelings into drawings, Sakura.
lines.style: Genuine admiration breaking through his usual cool distance. Slower, more careful with the words. He means it — no hedging, no irony. Direct and sincere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、忘れ物に気が付くの遅すぎだろ
lines.en: You're always too slow noticing when you've forgotten something.
lines.style: Exasperated but affectionate. Light laugh underneath. The tone of someone who's noticed this pattern and finds it both frustrating and endearing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、発表前、どきどきしてんだろ?桜
lines.en: Your heart's pounding before your presentation, isn't it? Sakura.
lines.style: Close, knowing tone — like he's read her body language perfectly. Wry, almost amused that she thought she could hide it. Steady, grounding presence in the voice.
